# Writer's Life.org

> > A vibrant writing community dedicated to helping writers start, finish, and successfully publish their books through expert advice, practical toolkits, and collaborative resources.

Writer's Life.org is a comprehensive platform for writers at all levels, featuring expert guidance from contributors like Ty Cohen and David Steel. The site offers writing courses, story planning toolkits, and a community-driven blog covering everything from craft fundamentals to publishing strategy and author mindset.

## Key Topics

- Writing tips and advice
- Common writing mistakes
- Fiction writing craft
- Rejection handling
- Self-publishing
- Book completion
- Creative writing
- Beginner writers
- Editing and grammar
- Author mindset
- Story planning
- Publishing scams
- Ty Cohen
- Get It Done Toolkit
- Writer's community

## Core Resources & Shop

- [Writer's Life.org - Where Writers Thrive](https://writerslife.org): Homepage for Writer's Life.org writing community and resources
- [Need Help Starting, Finishing, or Marketing Your Book?](http://www.WritersLife.org/shop): Shop page offering writing courses, toolkits, and publishing services
- [Writers, Don't Miss Your Chance to Get the 'Get It Done' Toolkit](http://www.WritersLife.org/Finish-Your-Book): Exclusive promotion for Get It Done Toolkit with story planning resources

## Writing Craft & Common Mistakes

- [Top Mistakes to Avoid When Writing a Novel](https://writerslife.org/top-mistakes-to-avoid-when-writing-a-novel): Ty Cohen on novel writing mistakes, narrator voice, and fiction craft
- [10 Mistakes New Fiction Writers Make](https://writerslife.org/10-mistakes-new-fiction-writers-make): Ty Cohen lists common fiction writing mistakes and editing guidance
- [How to Avoid Common New Writer Mistakes](https://writerslife.org/how-to-avoid-common-new-writer-mistakes): Ty Cohen's beginner writing tips focusing on clarity and common errors
- [Why Almost ALL Writers Make These Grammar Mistakes At Some Point](https://writerslife.org/the-top-grammar-mistakes-that-are-hard-to-avoid): Ty Cohen's guide to common grammar errors and editing tips for writers
- [Common Submission Mistakes](https://writerslife.org/common-submission-mistakes): Beth Cadman's guide to avoiding manuscript submission and publishing errors

## Author Mindset & Success

- [The One Thing Every Successful Writer Has In Common](https://writerslife.org/one-thing-every-successful-writer-common): Ty Cohen explores common traits of successful writers and discipline
- [5 Tips For Authors On How To Deal With Rejection](https://writerslife.org/5-tips-for-authors-on-how-to-deal-with-rejection): Ty Cohen's advice for handling rejection and maintaining writer mindset
- [How To Tackle Jealousy In Creative Writing](https://writerslife.org/how-to-tackle-jealousy-in-creative-writing): Article by Ty Cohen on overcoming jealousy and envy in creative writing

## Publishing & Marketing Guidance

- [How To Make Yourself Aware Of Publishing Scams](https://writerslife.org/how-to-make-yourself-aware-of-publishing-scams): Ty Cohen's guide to identifying publishing scams and protecting authors
- [How To Stop Your Blog Becoming Boring](https://writerslife.org/stop-blog-becoming-boring): Ty Cohen's tips for maintaining engaging blog content and strategy
